market_context: Stocks are rallying hard on Wednesday after Democrats swept Congress and Trump said he would accept the results. The Dow is up about 2.5-3%, and SPY is trading near its high of the day. Oil dropped more than 7%, the VIX fell about 18% to 17, and the 10-year yield eased to about 4.9%. Mega-cap names like AAPL, MSFT and AMZN are leading, while NVDA and AI data-center stocks lag on worries about new data-center limits.

predictions.reasoning: SPY is at 768.93, essentially at its day high of 769.01. Relief-rally momentum, falling oil, a falling VIX and easing yields support a modest afternoon drift higher. The rally is already large, so I expect only a small gain from here.

DIA is at 532.36, just under its day high of 532.74, as cyclicals and broad-economy names lead on lower oil and yields. Gridlock is seen as market-friendly and breadth is strong, with 353 S&P 500 holdings advancing. Follow-through into the close is slightly more likely than a fade.

NVDA is lagging a strong market, down 1.4% as AI data-center names sell off on fears of Democratic limits on data centers. It is down 5.4% over five days with no catalyst for a reversal, so the relative weakness probably persists into the close.
